items.headline: UN report urges sanctions over war-era abuses
items.summary: A new UN human rights report on attacks against aid workers, hospitals and relief operations in 2006–2009 finds no one has been prosecuted. It calls for an apology, reparations, an independent prosecutor and, where justice stalls, targeted sanctions.

items.headline: Sri Lanka and Russia sign anti-corruption pact
items.summary: Russia's visiting Prosecutor General signed a cooperation agreement with the Bribery Commission and pledged help in returning fugitives and tracing hidden assets.

items.headline: Rohitha Rajapaksa questioned over SupremeSAT
items.summary: The former President's youngest son gave a statement to the FCID in its probe into the SupremeSAT satellite deal, and later said no fraud allegation had been made against him.

items.headline: Eight killed in road accidents
items.summary: Eight people, including a 13-year-old girl who fell from a cab in Norwood, died in separate crashes across the island.

items.headline: Sri Lanka women win Emerging Nations title
items.summary: Sri Lanka beat Ireland by six wickets in the Emerging Nations T20 final in Ajman, bowling them out for 96 and chasing it down in under 13 overs.

items.headline: Vijitha Herath heads to IORA meeting
items.summary: The Foreign Minister left for New Delhi to lead Sri Lanka's delegation at the 25th Indian Ocean Rim Association ministerial meeting.

items.headline: New regional security roadmap
items.summary: At the Colombo Security Conclave, Sri Lanka joined India and the Maldives on a 2026–2027 roadmap and pressed for joint action on drugs, maritime threats and cybercrime.

items.headline: Deputy Minister's payslip challenge
items.summary: As public servants push for higher pay, a Deputy Minister challenged critics to compare payslips, defending the government's salary record.

items.headline: Mahinda Rajapaksa meets Indian envoy
items.summary: The former President met India's Deputy High Commissioner in Colombo.

items.headline: World Bank arm launches first rupee facility
items.summary: The IFC set up a six-year fixed-rate rupee borrowing line with HSBC Sri Lanka, backing a 10-year rupee loan to a renewable energy firm, its first infrastructure investment here since the crisis.

items.headline: Brazil deal to boost sugar output
items.summary: Sri Lanka signed an agreement worth about US$536,000 with Brazil to help raise local sugar production.

items.headline: Cruise ship brings 1,600 tourists
items.summary: The cruise liner Cordelia Empress docked in Colombo carrying around 1,600 visitors.

items.headline: Stocks close higher
items.summary: Colombo share indices ended the day in positive territory on muted trading.

items.headline: Yoshitha Rajapaksa case set for Dec 3
items.summary: Further evidence in the money laundering case against Yoshitha Rajapaksa will be heard on December 3.

items.headline: Two held over garbage dumped near reservoir
items.summary: Two people were arrested after Gampola's waste was dumped illegally near the Moragahakanda Reservoir.

items.headline: Prabhakaran birthday event in Jaffna
items.summary: More than 100 people attended an event in Jaffna marking the LTTE leader's birthday.

items.headline: HIV rising among young adults
items.summary: Health officials report a rise in HIV infections among people aged 20 to 24.

items.headline: Amber thunderstorm warning for 18 districts
items.summary: The Met Department upgraded its alert to amber for severe thunderstorms in 18 districts, with over 100 mm of rain and strong lightning possible tonight in six provinces.

items.headline: Pathirana, Hasaranga in top IPL bracket
items.summary: Seven Sri Lankans have registered for the IPL 2027 auction in Goa on December 16, with Pathirana and Hasaranga at the highest base price.

items.headline: Clive Lloyd backs Test Twenty
items.summary: The West Indies great, visiting Sri Lanka, said the new Test Twenty format could help develop future international players.

items.headline: Sri Lankan refugee dies after UK resettlement
items.summary: A Sri Lankan refugee once held on Diego Garcia died in September after the UK quietly resettled him in Eswatini under an undisclosed deal, it has emerged.

items.headline: Bangkok oil depot blast injures seven
items.summary: A large explosion at an oil depot in Bangkok injured seven people, four critically.

items.headline: Oil prices climb on Iran mine claims
items.summary: Crude rose on supply worries after Iran claimed mine strikes on ships.
